cover.report_type: Interim Report: April 5 (for the period ending March 31, 2006)

_meta.notes: Handwritten 2006-era form; candidate signs his full legal name 'SIMARJIT S. GILL' (the clerk listing says 'Sim Gill'). No dollar signs are written; figures recorded as printed. Lines 3 and 7 are written without a thousands comma (5966.01 / 5459.60). Balance summary is internally consistent.

contributions.detail: delta of 1.27, CAUSE IDENTIFIED AND BENIGN. The 70 transcribed rows sum to 11639.50 against the attachment's printed total of $11,640.77. The gap is exactly the cents the spreadsheet's Amount column DISPLAYS AWAY on its two in-kind rows: Patrick A. Shea prints $346 where the matching Schedule B in-kind entry is 346.47, and Denise Dragoo prints $656 where its Schedule B counterpart is 656.80. 0.47 + 0.80 = 1.27 to the cent. The printed total was computed on the unrounded values; the row amounts are transcribed VERBATIM as displayed and were NOT adjusted to close the total.

expenditures.detail: exact (12147.18 = 12147.18). p4 rows sum 9743.46 = its printed SUBTOTAL; p5 rows sum 2403.72 = its printed SUBTOTAL; 9743.46 + 2403.72 = 12147.18 = the printed TOTAL on both pages = Summary Page line 2 Column A.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Expenditures: p4 rows 9743.46 = printed SUBTOTAL 9,743.46 - PASSED (14 rows); p5 rows 2403.72 = printed SUBTOTAL 2,403.72 - PASSED (10 rows), AND THAT GATE ADJUDICATED A DIGIT (row 5's cramped superscript cents, 21.61 not 21.11). Contributions: the printed Schedule A (p3) is empty apart from 'See attachment A' with no subtotal or total, and Attachment A prints no per-page subtotals - only the grand total $11,640.77, against which the rows sum to 11639.50. THAT GATE DOES NOT CLOSE and both figures are named here; the 1.27 gap is fully explained by two whole-dollar DISPLAY roundings on the in-kind rows (see recon) and no row was adjusted.
itemized.escalation_note: p5 row-5 amount cell re-rendered twice at 900 dpi with contrast normalisation (the first crop landed on the neighbouring row); the cents group resolved to 61, agreeing with the page subtotal. Attachment A pages re-rendered at 240 dpi - they are landscape pages that poppler already renders wide, so no rotation was needed.
itemized.notes: Handwritten Schedule B, TYPED contribution attachment. p3 is Schedule A carrying only 'See attachment A' (header box 'Page 2 of 6 / GILL / 4/4/06'); the contribution itemization is the two-page typed 'Attachment A / Sim Gill For DA' (PDF p6-p7, hand-numbered '5 of 6' and '6 of 6'). Schedule B is two handwritten pages (PDF p4-p5, form pages 3 and 4 of 6) - the '3' on p4 is written over a struck-out earlier digit. ATTACHMENT A'S Address / City / St / Zip / Phone COLUMNS ARE ALL BLANK with three stray digit fragments surviving mid-column, i.e. a county redaction, so no donor city or state is recoverable. THREE IN-KIND ITEMS appear on BOTH sides and reconcile across them: the January fundraiser food (400.00) and two Alta Club food items booked to 'Sim Gill for DA.' whose Schedule B values 346.47 and 656.80 match the Attachment A rows for Patrick A. Shea and Denise Dragoo, displayed there rounded to $346 and $656 - which is exactly why the contribution side misses its own printed total by 1.27. Cents are written as raised superscripts over a rule throughout Schedule B and are transcribed with a decimal point. Notable donors on the contribution side include the sitting Salt Lake County District Attorney (David E. Yocom, the incumbent this candidate was running to succeed), the Salt Lake County Mayor (Peter Corroon) and the Mayor of Alta. Filer spelling kept verbatim: 'Campaign Manger'. One expenditure is the filing fee paid to Sherrie Swensen, the County Clerk.
